mapper.select: SELECT GREATEST(0,IF(#{subject}='deposit',o.deposit_paid_amount_fen,o.rent_paid_amount_fen) -COALESCE((SELECT SUM(IF(#{subject}='deposit',r.deposit_refund_amount_fen,r.rent_refund_amount_fen)) FROM refund_order r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.refund_status!='cancelled'),0) -COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.amount_fen) FROM order_deduction d WHERE d.rental_order_id=o.id AND d.fund_component=#{subject} AND d.deduction_status IN ('pending','confirmed')),0)) FROM rental_order o WHERE o.id=#{order}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_compensation_receivable(id,receivable_no,rental_order_id,buyer_user_id,factory_id,source_type,source_id, confirmed_loss_amount_fen,available_deposit_amount_fen,deposit_deducted_amount_fen,receivable_amount_fen,paid_amount_fen,waived_amount_fen,receivable_status, effective_at,version,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{id},CONCAT('RC',#{id}),id,buyer_user_id,factory_id,#{type},#{source},#{loss},#{available},#{deduction}, #{loss}-#{deduction},0,0,'pending',#{at},0,#{at},#{at} FROM rental_order WHERE id=#{order}
